profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Storybox
profile.summary: Hi, my name is Justin! I'm a former professional broadcaster and event organizer who has transitioned into a front-end web developer. Nice to meet you!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built a full-stack app with Next.js and React, utilizing REST APIs for data management.
• Used AWS (Lambda, EC2, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions) and Google Cloud to create scalable workflows.
• Designed SQL-based data architecture and optimized data flows for performance and reliability.
• Automated game server deployment and custom IP domain assignment for dynamic configurations.
• Implemented AWS EventBridge for microservice communication and real-time event orchestration.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering · Software Design · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Improve UI/UX that were used to demo and win Dempsey 2023
• Implemented blog post tool that allows for front-end display of various web articles and back-end functionality for creating new posts.
• Refactored with languages and technologies such as React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Azure Cosmos DB.
• Designed and developed RESTful APIs to provide efficient communication between client applications and server systems.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Oral Communication · Agile Development · Computer Engineering

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed RESTful API's using C# in order to store and read git commit data.
• Worked with Open AI API in order to assist product manager role to summarize and turn commit data into release notes bi-weekly.
• Communicated with product owner and met on a week to week basis in order to update on delieverables.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · React.js · TypeScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Bootstrap

positions.title: Event Organizer
positions.description:
• Ran events under strict timelines to ensure that events are consistent across multiple iterations
• Managed budgets and logistics with flying in high level talent for regional events
• Gathering feedback from event participants to identify key areas of improvement for future events
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Collaborative Problem Solving · Leadership · Event Management · Event Planning · Time Management · Teamwork · Critical Thinking

positions.title: Broadcasting and Production
positions.description:
• Troubleshooted equipment issues in real time situations which posed risk to live broadcasts of thousands of viewers.
• Remembered and articulated players timelines to create interesting narratives for live audience
• Adjusting communication style based off of abilities of rotating co-commentators
positions.insights: Skills: Oral Communication · Organization Skills · OBS · Leadership · Interpersonal Communication · Communication · Critical Thinking

positions.title: Security Officer
positions.description:
• Resolved disputes between uncooperative persons who disrupted public ordinance
• Maintained excellent rapport with residents of each site in order to create sense of trust.
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · Oral Communication · Patrol · Communication · Critical Thinking · Law Enforcement · Physical Security
